note: Canonical investor seat structure, LD-2026-017 (2026-09-09). Registered here under DWS_TRUTH_STANDARD §3A because this number is repeated across 100+ investor-facing files and had drifted FOUR times in six months while living only in a decision log. Every drift reached live investor-facing pages before it was caught. The deprecatedDisplayPhrases below are the three superseded structures; the linter FAILs on them so a regression cannot reach public copy silently.

tiers.name: Industry Captain
tiers.note: An investment tier, not a client role (HIC 2026-09-09, dialog item D5). The separate 'Captain' vs 'Industry Captain' labels name the same seat; 'Industry Captain' is the current label.

tiers.name: Deputy Captain
tiers.note: SHELVED by HIC 2026-09-09 (dialog item D3) — not retired, not sellable. EUR 250,000 + 8 x EUR 50,000 = EUR 650,000 exactly, so there is no room for a Deputy inside the round. Must not appear on live investor surfaces or be quoted to an investor while shelved.

tiers.name: Captain triple bundle
tiers.note: RETIRED by HIC 2026-09-09 (dialog item D4). Came from LD-2026-014; absent from the investor-centre surface.
